name: Ratio
flavor_text: You do not counter the spell. You quote-tweet it into oblivion.
rules_text: When a creature within range uses a spell or activated ability, force a WIS save or the ability fails and the target becomes Stunned until the start of its next turn.

name: Read Receipts Off
flavor_text: The sacred power of plausible delay enters your bones.
rules_text: You gain advantage on saves against social obligation, notification pressure, and guilt-based compulsion. For the duration, creatures have disadvantage on checks made to determine whether you saw their message.

name: Meeting That Could Have Been An Email
flavor_text: A calendar invite manifests where joy used to live.
rules_text: Affected creatures that fail their WIS save take psychic damage and gain Bored for 3 rounds. A creature already Bored becomes Stunned for 1 round instead.
